Nothing beats a warm bowl of soup on a chilly winter day! In this video, discover 4 delicious and comforting soup recipes that are easy to prepare and packed with flavour.
From light and refreshing shorbas to creamy, hearty soups, there's something for everyone!
Today's Recipes:
Carrot & Coriander Soup – A smooth, flavourful soup made with fresh carrots, coriander and aromatic spices.
Beetroot Shorba – A vibrant and wholesome beetroot soup with a delicious blend of ginger, garlic and spices.
Garlic Chickpea Soup – A creamy, hearty soup made with chickpeas, garlic, potatoes and herbs.
